name: Weather — animated
description: A full-screen animated weather scene: the sky, rain, snow or sun follow the current conditions, with a five-day forecast and temperature ranges. Reads one of your Weather data sources; your server fetches the weather, so this template needs no network access at all.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: weather
params.label: Weather data source
params.help: A data source of type Weather (Data Sources → New → Weather). Its location, units and language are set there.

params.name: location
params.label: Location name
params.help: Leave empty to use the data source's own place name.

params.name: background
params.label: Solid background colour
params.help: Used when Background is set to Solid colour.

params.name: animate
params.label: Animate the scene
params.help: Turn off for very low-powered players.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Clock timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Clock and date language
params.help: For example en-GB. Leave empty for the screen's language.
